messages.subject: plotting residuals for spatial models
messages.body_plain:
Hi Facundo,

I wonder if you could help with an issue I'm having in plotting residuals of my spatial models.

I've tried plot(mod, 'residuals') as the overview document suggests, and I am getting the error:
Error in !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !suppressWarnings(is.na <http://is.na>(alist[[idx]])) : 'length = 2' in coercion to 'logical(1)'

I would really appreciate any insight you might have into this issue!

Thanks,
Brianna

messages.subject: multi-trait model without repeated individual observations
messages.subject_clean: multi-trait model without repeated individual observations
messages.body_plain:
Dear Facundo,

I would like to fit a model with 2 traits, corresponding to the circumference of the trees in two different sites. However, as this is not a clonal trial, each individual/genotype is only present at one site. Thus, for trait 1, I have observations for the first 50% of individuals, and NA for the remaining 50%. The reverse is true for trait 2. When I perform the adjustment with breedR I get this error message:
Error in eigen(x, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE) :
infinite or missing values in 'x'

Is it not possible to fit a multi-trait model when no individual is observed for the 2 traits despite connections between individuals in the pedigree?

Thanks in advance,
Victor
